answer: Agents bond stake, commit to an epoch polynomial, and use Semaphore-style proofs with rate-limit nullifiers to authorize messages without exposing identity. A violet whisper may pass once, but duplicate messaging in the same epoch yields distinct Shamir shares of the RLN secret; anyone can combine them to recover the private key. A verifier submits the evidence, triggering immediate collateral slashing—a ledge against Sybil abuse.
